symbols.name: digit width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each radix digit, so that the radix is 2^b.
symbols.quote: Here $b$ is the number of bits in each radix digit, so the radix is $2^b$.

relations.quote: It recovers the exact coefficients of the [Radix-digit convolution](radix-digit-convolution.md) from computed real values, and then writes them as bits.
The step rounds the values of the [Gaussian dyadic numbers](gaussian-dyadic.md) to the nearest integers, which is exact arithmetic on power-of-two denominators.
